title: Integrations
subtitle: Slack, webhooks, email, and more — wire how SolidPing reaches you.
newSubtitle: Pick the integration type to configure.
editSubtitle: Secret values are stored encrypted; updating them replaces the stored value.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this integration?
deleteConfirm.body: Bound checks lose this notification target. The action cannot be undone.

empty.title: No integrations yet
empty.body: Add an integration to start receiving notifications. Pick one to get going:

form.name: Name
form.defaultHelp: Pre-checked when creating a new check. Existing checks are unaffected.
form.msteamsWebhookHint: In Teams, open Workflows → "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received", finish the wizard, then paste the workflow URL it gives you here. The legacy "Incoming Webhook" connector is retired and will not work.
form.recipientsHint: Separate addresses with a space, comma, semicolon, or newline — or paste a list.
form.recipientsInvalidHint: Fix or remove the highlighted address before saving.
form.twilioSenderHint: Provide exactly one sender: a from-number or a Messaging Service SID.
form.twilioVoiceHint: Leave empty to disable voice calls.
form.twilioToHint: Direct-channel sends (per-check broadcast, test) text these numbers.
form.slackOauthHint: Slack channels are configured via the Slack OAuth install. The bot will populate workspace and channel names on completion.
form.slackNotConnectedBody: This channel has no linked Slack workspace. Install the SolidPing Slack app to connect one.
form.testHelp: Deliver a sample alert to confirm this integration is wired up. The test uses the saved settings.
form.testNeedsSave: Save your changes first — the test uses the saved settings.
form.msteamsBotCreateHint: Create the integration first, then install the Teams app package and run the link command shown here to connect your Microsoft 365 tenant.
form.msteamsBotDisabledTitle: The Teams bot is disabled on this server
form.msteamsBotDisabledBody: Enable it in the server settings. Microsoft must be able to reach this instance over public HTTPS — a firewalled deployment cannot use the Teams bot.
form.msteamsBotEndpointHint: Microsoft must be able to reach this messaging endpoint over public HTTPS:
form.msteamsBotSideloadHint: In Teams, open Apps → Manage your apps → Upload a custom app, pick this zip, then add SolidPing to a team. The channel you add it to becomes a notification destination.
form.msteamsBotUninstalled: The Teams app was removed from this tenant. Reinstall it to resume notifications.
form.msteamsBotNoDestinations: No Teams channels yet. Add SolidPing to a channel in Teams and it will appear here.
form.msteamsBotNotConnectedBody: Install the Teams app package, then run the link command below in any channel the bot was added to.
form.msteamsBotLinkCodeHint: In a Teams channel where SolidPing was added, send this message. The code can be used once and expires in 30 minutes.
form.msteamsBotLinkFailed: Could not create a link code
form.msteamsBotDownloadFailed: Could not download the Teams app package
form.msteamsBotLinkFirst: Connect a Microsoft 365 tenant first — channels appear here once the bot is added to them.
form.slackMentionOnCall: Mention the on-call person in alerts
form.slackMentionOnCallHelp: New and escalated incident messages start by @-mentioning whoever the escalation policy pages first. Members without a mapped Slack account are named in plain text.
form.slackMemberMappingHelp: Which SolidPing members we can @-mention on this workspace. Matched automatically by email; override any row manually.
form.slackMappingError: Could not load the member mapping.

freebox.name: Freebox
freebox.description: Monitor your Freebox line quality and network status
freebox.baseUrlHint: Leave as-is if SolidPing runs on the same LAN as the Freebox. For remote access, use the public hostname you configured in the Freebox admin under Settings → Freebox OS API.
freebox.deviceNameHint: Shown on the Freebox admin under Authorized apps. Pick something you'll recognise later.
freebox.pressArrow: Go to your Freebox and press → on the LCD within 30 seconds
freebox.pairingTimeout: The Freebox LCD prompt expired before approval. Try again.
freebox.pairingDenied: The pairing was rejected on the Freebox.
freebox.pairingFailed: Could not reach the Freebox. Double-check the base URL.

kubernetes.name: Kubernetes
kubernetes.description: Connect a Kubernetes cluster to monitor workload replica health
kubernetes.inClusterHint: Uses the service-account token mounted in SolidPing's own pod. Only works when SolidPing runs inside the target cluster; no credentials are stored.
kubernetes.insecureHelp: Disables API-server certificate verification. Use only for clusters with a self-signed cert you cannot pin.
kubernetes.testHelp: Probe the cluster API to confirm the credentials work. Uses the saved settings.
